<div class="prep-widget">
  <svg
    class="prep-svg"
    viewBox="0 0 879 645"
    preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet"
    xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
    role="img"
    aria-label="Preparación - Lavadora Línea 2"
  >
    <defs>
      <!-- Contornos originales con esquinas redondeadas -->
      <clipPath
        id="prep4-tank-top-clip"
        clipPathUnits="userSpaceOnUse"
      >
        <rect
          x="81"
          y="95"
          width="624"
          height="37"
          rx="6"
          ry="6"
        />
      </clipPath>

      <clipPath
        id="prep4-tank-middle-clip"
        clipPathUnits="userSpaceOnUse"
      >
        <rect
          x="39"
          y="227"
          width="743"
          height="37"
          rx="6"
          ry="6"
        />
      </clipPath>

      <clipPath
        id="prep4-tank-bottom-clip"
        clipPathUnits="userSpaceOnUse"
      >
        <rect
          x="39"
          y="360"
          width="743"
          height="38"
          rx="6"
          ry="6"
        />
      </clipPath>

      <!-- POLEAS: mismo metal satinado de los widgets anteriores -->
      <linearGradient
        id="prep4-roller-metal"
        x1="15%"
        y1="0%"
        x2="85%"
        y2="100%"
      >
        <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#EFF0F2" />
        <stop offset="24%" stop-color="#E2E3E6" />
        <stop offset="43%" class="roller-metal-base" />
        <stop offset="56%" stop-color="#E7E8EA" />
        <stop offset="74%" class="roller-metal-base" />
        <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#C3C5CA" />
      </linearGradient>

      <!-- CUBAS: reflejo metálico suave -->
      <linearGradient
        id="prep4-tank-metal"
        x1="0%"
        y1="0%"
        x2="0%"
        y2="100%"
      >
        <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ECEEF0" />
        <stop offset="16%" stop-color="#E2E4E7" />
        <stop offset="46%" class="tank-metal-base" />
        <stop offset="62%" stop-color="#E2E3E6" />
        <stop offset="84%" class="tank-metal-base" />
        <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#C6C8CD" />
      </linearGradient>

      <!-- Franjas azules -->
      <linearGradient
        id="prep4-liquid-gradient"
        x1="0%"
        y1="0%"
        x2="0%"
        y2="100%"
      >
        <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#B3D9EE" />
        <stop offset="40%" class="tank-liquid-base" />
        <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#96C5E1" />
      </linearGradient>

      <!-- POLEAS: sombra ambiental y sombra de contacto -->
      <filter
        id="prep4-roller-shadow"
        x="-30%"
        y="-30%"
        width="160%"
        height="175%"
        color-interpolation-filters="sRGB"
      >
        <feGaussianBlur
          in="SourceAlpha"
          stdDeviation="1.5"
          result="rollerAmbientBlur"
        />
        <feOffset
          in="rollerAmbientBlur"
          dx="0.3"
          dy="2"
          result="rollerAmbientOffset"
        />
        <feFlood
          flood-color="#18212D"
          flood-opacity="0.12"
          result="rollerAmbientColor"
        />
        <feComposite
          in="rollerAmbientColor"
          in2="rollerAmbientOffset"
          operator="in"
          result="rollerAmbientShadow"
        />

        <feGaussianBlur
          in="SourceAlpha"
          stdDeviation="0.4"
          result="rollerContactBlur"
        />
        <feOffset
          in="rollerContactBlur"
          dx="0"
          dy="0.65"
          result="rollerContactOffset"
        />
        <feFlood
          flood-color="#111820"
          flood-opacity="0.17"
          result="rollerContactColor"
        />
        <feComposite
          in="rollerContactColor"
          in2="rollerContactOffset"
          operator="in"
          result="rollerContactShadow"
        />

        <feMerge>
          <feMergeNode in="rollerAmbientShadow" />
          <feMergeNode in="rollerContactShadow" />
          <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic" />
        </feMerge>
      </filter>

      <!-- CUBAS: sombra ambiental y sombra de contacto -->
      <filter
        id="prep4-tank-shadow"
        x="-3%"
        y="-35%"
        width="106%"
        height="185%"
        color-interpolation-filters="sRGB"
      >
        <feGaussianBlur
          in="SourceAlpha"
          stdDeviation="2"
          result="tankAmbientBlur"
        />
        <feOffset
          in="tankAmbientBlur"
          dx="0"
          dy="2.5"
          result="tankAmbientOffset"
        />
        <feFlood
          flood-color="#18212D"
          flood-opacity="0.10"
          result="tankAmbientColor"
        />
        <feComposite
          in="tankAmbientColor"
          in2="tankAmbientOffset"
          operator="in"
          result="tankAmbientShadow"
        />

        <feGaussianBlur
          in="SourceAlpha"
          stdDeviation="0.5"
          result="tankContactBlur"
        />
        <feOffset
          in="tankContactBlur"
          dx="0"
          dy="0.8"
          result="tankContactOffset"
        />
        <feFlood
          flood-color="#111820"
          flood-opacity="0.15"
          result="tankContactColor"
        />
        <feComposite
          in="tankContactColor"
          in2="tankContactOffset"
          operator="in"
          result="tankContactShadow"
        />

        <feMerge>
          <feMergeNode in="tankAmbientShadow" />
          <feMergeNode in="tankContactShadow" />
          <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic" />
        </feMerge>
      </filter>

      <!-- Sombra interior discreta de las franjas azules -->
      <filter
        id="prep4-liquid-inset"
        x="-2%"
        y="-20%"
        width="104%"
        height="140%"
        color-interpolation-filters="sRGB"
      >
        <feGaussianBlur
          in="SourceAlpha"
          stdDeviation="0.7"
          result="liquidBlur"
        />
        <feOffset
          in="liquidBlur"
          dx="0"
          dy="0.8"
          result="liquidOffset"
        />
        <feComposite
          in="SourceAlpha"
          in2="liquidOffset"
          operator="out"
          result="liquidInnerEdge"
        />
        <feFlood
          flood-color="#315F79"
          flood-opacity="0.16"
          result="liquidShadowColor"
        />
        <feComposite
          in="liquidShadowColor"
          in2="liquidInnerEdge"
          operator="in"
          result="liquidInnerShadow"
        />

        <feMerge>
          <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic" />
          <feMergeNode in="liquidInnerShadow" />
        </feMerge>
      </filter>
    </defs>

    <!--
      CUBAS

      Posiciones y dimensiones exteriores originales.
      Franjas azules desde la mitad de cada cuba.
      Margen lateral e inferior: 4 unidades SVG.
      Las cuerdas y poleas quedan por delante.
    -->
    <g class="tanks">
      <!-- Cuba superior: 624 × 37 -->
      <g class="tank-group">
        <g clip-path="url(#prep4-tank-top-clip)">
          <rect
            class="tank-upper"
            x="81"
            y="95"
            width="624"
            height="37"
          />

          <rect
            class="tank-lower"
            x="85"
            y="113.5"
            width="616"
            height="14.5"
            rx="3"
            ry="3"
          />

          <path
            class="tank-top-highlight"
            d="M 88 96.2 L 698 96.2"
          />

          <path
            class="tank-bottom-shade"
            d="M 88 130.8 L 698 130.8"
          />
        </g>

        <rect
          class="tank-outline"
          x="81"
          y="95"
          width="624"
          height="37"
          rx="6"
          ry="6"
        />
      </g>

      <!-- Cuba intermedia: 743 × 37 -->
      <g class="tank-group">
        <g clip-path="url(#prep4-tank-middle-clip)">
          <rect
            class="tank-upper"
            x="39"
            y="227"
            width="743"
            height="37"
          />

          <rect
            class="tank-lower"
            x="43"
            y="245.5"
            width="735"
            height="14.5"
            rx="3"
            ry="3"
          />

          <path
            class="tank-top-highlight"
            d="M 46 228.2 L 775 228.2"
          />

          <path
            class="tank-bottom-shade"
            d="M 46 262.8 L 775 262.8"
          />
        </g>

        <rect
          class="tank-outline"
          x="39"
          y="227"
          width="743"
          height="37"
          rx="6"
          ry="6"
        />
      </g>

      <!-- Cuba inferior: 743 × 38 -->
      <g class="tank-group">
        <g clip-path="url(#prep4-tank-bottom-clip)">
          <rect
            class="tank-upper"
            x="39"
            y="360"
            width="743"
            height="38"
          />

          <rect
            class="tank-lower"
            x="43"
            y="379"
            width="735"
            height="15"
            rx="3"
            ry="3"
          />

          <path
            class="tank-top-highlight"
            d="M 46 361.2 L 775 361.2"
          />

          <path
            class="tank-bottom-shade"
            d="M 46 396.8 L 775 396.8"

        <rect

    </g>

    <!-- CONDENSADO: recorridos originales -->
    <g class="condensate-system">
      <!-- Columna izquierda -->
      <path
        class="condensate-line"
        d="M 128 132 L 128 159 L 103 159 L 103 597"
      />

      <path
        class="condensate-line"
        d="M 128 264 L 128 292 L 103 292"
      />

      <!-- Columna derecha -->
      <path
        class="condensate-line"
        d="M 489 132 L 489 159 L 462 159 L 462 597"

      />

      <!-- Colector principal -->
      <path

    </g>

    <!--
      VAPOR

      Las tuberías terminan en los bordes de las válvulas.
      Los retornos compartidos con el condensado se dibujan

    -->

      <!-- Subidas principales -->

      <path
        class="steam-line"

      <!-- Superior izquierda -->

        d="

      />

      <!-- Intermedia izquierda -->
      <path

      <path

      <!-- Intermedia derecha -->
      <path

      <path

      />

      <!-- Inferior derecha -->
      <path

      <!-- Colector principal -->
      <path

    <!-- CONTROL: coordenadas originales -->
    <g class="control-system">
      <!-- Superior izquierda -->

        />
      </g>

      <!-- Superior derecha -->
      <g
        class="valve valve-vertical"

      >

          class="valve-link"
          x1="0" y1="0"
          x2="15.5" y2="0"
        />

        <path class="valve-body" d="M -9 -9 L 9 -9 L 0 0 Z" />
        <path class="valve-body" d="M -9 9 L 9 9 L 0 0 Z" />

        <ellipse
          class="valve-dot"
          cx="15.5"
          cy="0"
          rx="1.5"
          ry="6.5"
        />
      </g>

      <!-- Intermedia derecha -->
      <g

        <line

    <!-- CUERDA PRINCIPAL: recorrido original íntegro -->

    <!-- NUMERACIÓN: negra, centrada y de 13 px -->

"use strict";

/*
 * Preparación — Lavadora Línea 2.
 *
 * Widget gráfico completamente estático.
 *
 * El acabado metálico, los reflejos y las sombras se definen
 * mediante SVG y CSS.
 *
 * Se conserva el recorrido original de las cuerdas,
 * incluida la curva Bézier entre las poleas 78 y 80/79.
 *
 * No utiliza tags, variables del PLC, WIDGET, onWidgetUpdate,
 * temporizadores, animaciones ni recursos externos.
 */
